title: EngineParams
description: Consolidated engine-tunable knobs. Sections are added by each implementing SPEC (tick, fog, credibility, committee). Content-only — no engine logic here.

history_size.description: Maximum number of prior snapshots retained in state.history. Default 24 (two years of monthly ticks).

fog.description: Per-series fog parameters. Populated by SPEC-FOG-1.

noise_scale.description: Standard deviation of Gaussian noise added to the observed value.

lag_months.description: How many months behind current state the observation is drawn from. 0 = current.

credibility.description: Credibility spiral parameters. Populated by SPEC-CRED-4.

anchor_threshold.description: Credibility level at or above which expectations remain anchored. SPEC-CRED-2 threshold; gates SPEC-CRED-4 spiral entry.

consecutive_months.description: Ticks below anchor_threshold required before the spiral activates.

drift_per_period.description: Per-month widening of the expectations gap once the spiral is active.

recovery_rate.description: Per-month recovery of expectations_anchor toward target_inflation.

target_inflation.description: Long-run inflation target that expectations_anchor converges to on recovery.

committee.description: FOMC committee parameters. Populated by SPEC-COMM-2.

dissent_tolerance.description: Absolute rate difference above which a member is counted as dissenting.

hawkish_inflation_weight.description: Factor by which hawkish members scale the inflation gap when computing preferred rate.

dovish_unemployment_weight.description: Factor by which dovish members scale the unemployment gap when computing preferred rate.

neutral_blend.description: Weight of the inflation gap in the neutral member blend (0..1); unemployment weight is 1 - neutral_blend.

target_inflation.description: Long-run inflation target used by all member types when computing gap_inflation.

target_unemployment.description: Natural rate of unemployment used by all member types when computing gap_unemployment.
